units: <cite ref="Chullin 33a:7">Ḥull. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>חוֹתֵךְ כזית וכ׳</he> cuts out flesh of the size of an olive.
<cite ref="Chullin 32a:3">Ib. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ דלעת וכ׳</he> if in slaughtering he cut a pumpkin at the same time.
<cite ref="Chullin 48b">Ib. 48ᵇ</cite> a. e. <he>חוֹתְכָהּ מכאן וכ׳</he> he amputates on one place and the animal survives &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:1">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>חוֹתְכָהּ באיר</he> he may sever the wick over the light.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:2:2">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵃ</cite> <he>חותך</he> the reader cuts one verse into two (reading <cite ref="Genesis 1:5">Gen. I, 5</cite>, a.
I, 8 as two verses severally); a. fr.—[Lev. R. s. 10 לחתוך את אביו וכ׳, v. חָתַר.]—Part. pass. חָתוּךְ cut into, having the incisions of limbs &c., outlined.

<cite ref="Niddah 24b:6">Nidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>גוף שאינו ח׳</he> a shapeless body (not articulated); <he>ראש שאינו ח׳</he> a shapeless head (without indications of the nose &c.) Ib. 24ᵃ <he>יד חֲתוּכָה</he> a well-shaped hand (of an embryo); a. fr.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>התוך</he>, <cite ref="Jeremiah 39:3">Jer. XXXIX, 3</cite>) <he>ששם חוֹתְכִין את ההלכה</he> for there they decide the practice.
<cite ref="Jeremiah 39:3">Ib.</cite> <he>וחוֹתֶכֶת דיניהם וכ׳</he> and decides the cases &c.
<cite ref="Shevuot 30b:15">Shebu. 30ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אֶחְתְּכֶנּוּ</he> I will decide the case (in accordance with the testimony).—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 4:2:2">Y. Snh. IV, beg. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אילו … התורה חתוכה</he> if the Law had been given in the form of clear decisions (leaving no room for differences of opinion, discretion &c.)

senses.gloss: to be cut off, severed; to be cut into.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 4:6">Ḥull. IV, 6</cite> <he>שנֶחְתְּכוּ רגליה</he> whose feet have been amputated.

<cite ref="Chullin 32a:3">Ib. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>נֶחְתְּכָה דלעת וכ׳</he> if by accident a pumpkin has been cut simultaneously with the animal (opp. to <cite ref="H01896"><he>חָתַךְ</he></cite>, v. supra); a. fr.

<cite ref="Megillah 15a:11">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ה̇ת̇ך̇</he>, <cite ref="Esther 4:5">Esth. IV, 5</cite>) <he>שכל … נֶחְ֗תָּ֗כִ֗ין על יפיו</he> all the government affairs were decided upon his opinion.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 4:2">Ḥull. IV, 2</cite> <he>מְחַתֵּךְ אבר אבר</he> he may cut off limb after limb.
Ib. 98ᵇ מחתך לה וכ׳ he carves the foreleg and then boils it.—Part. pass. מְחוּתָּךְ piecemeal, limbwise. Y. Nidd. III, 50ᶜ יצא מח׳ if the embryo came out by pieces.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:16">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>צדק … חַתְּכֵהוּ</he> make the case clear and then decide it.
<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:29">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>לשון מְחַתֵּךְ וכ׳</he> the tongue forms the sentence, the mouth closes (the case, makes it irreversible).

<cite ref="Ketubot 77a:13">Keth. 77ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>מצרף</he>) <he>המְחַתֵּךְ … מעיקרו</he> he who digs copper in the shaft. [<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 4:3">Tosef. Ohol. IV, 3</cite> <he>וחיתכו</he>, <he>וחתכו</he>, read: <he>והִתִּיכוֹ</he> or <he>והִיתְּכוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="N01379"><he>נָתַךְ</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00949"><he>התך</he></cite>.]
